reviews.x: I purchased these specifically because my hair is THIN. Unfortunately, these clips are not really made for thin hair, they are too big. Disappointed.
I purchased these specifically because my hair is THIN. Unfortunately, these clips are not really made for thin hair, they are too big. Disappointed.

I've been using this style of hair claw for years, but recently haven't been able to find them elsewhere. They are the only large hair claws that can hold my hair, all other clips slide right through. I'm glad to find them here on Amazon.

reviews.t: Take more measurements into consideration & your set!
reviews.x: Quite smaller than I expected, you can't just measure the size of another clip with 'this just an inch shorter would be perfect' in mind, you have to consider an inch shorter usually also means a half inch or so less wide and deep. If you take that into consideration they are great clips. Still a bit pricey for the size when I purchased though. Colors are pretty close to the pictures! Hope this helps!

Just the right size to pull my hair up off my face. Stays secure all day. I'm not sure it would be secure enough for someone with very thick hair. I have very fine hair of about medium thickness. Just good no-nonsense clips that are much smaller than the gigantic butterfly clips that I have used in a previous decade. Would definitely purchase again.
I have thin hair... they hold it perfectly... would like to purchase a few more packages of these...but there saying out of stock... please try to get them back in stock!!
Kinda disappointed. These look like ones I have seen at the dollar tree. I guess we will see how they hold up.

I've been looking for these hair clips for awhile and I haven't seen them available at any of the stores I normally shop in.  I decided to check if Amazon had any and they did!  So easy to order and they were delivered in 2 days.  These are the perfect size for me as I have medium length thin hair.  Thank you.

reviews.t: Holds my hair but has issues
reviews.x: These clips are impossible to open with one hand. You have to open them with one hand as your other hand is holding your hair. Poor design on the tabs to open them with. They are too short. They do a good job once in your hair. I will break them sooner or later from popping out of my hand onto the floor.

These were not a good value. It’s something I could have purchased at the dollar store. I was hoping for slightly better quality. They do work, there’s nothing wrong with them, just not a great value.
Pictures in listing are deceptive.  These clips are small and will not hold, for example, a french twist pony.  They may hold smaller pieces of hair, but these are headed back due to the size.
I had a few of these many years ago and recently my last one broke, my fault. I was very happy to see they were still available as I couldn’t find them in my stores. Love them.

reviews.t: Worked fine with medium length fine wavy hair
reviews.x: Worked great for a year and a half. Dropped on on a cement floor and it broke at hung, so I’m buying another pack.

This is an overall comment relative to the nature of people and their experience with said product. If you know anything about people we are all different and interpret mostly from THEIR feelings. I don't find them helpful and extremely biased. A reviewer commented that the product didn't work for thin and fine hair. That's not true since it did work for me and my fine hair thinning at the crown. My takeaway is bye the dam thing and see for yourself.

These clips were gorgeous and comfortable! But they just weren’t sturdy enough for my hair, or didn't last too long. The claws started to break off within a month. I do have thick hair but i would only use these to hold some of my hair not all of it and it would always just slip out of my hair, they had no grip at all. Other than that they were okay.

reviews.t: Spring Sprongy! Jumpsright out of my hand!
reviews.x: Shipped super quick, pretty packaging. Nice looking clips. But the spring mechanism is waaay to strong! When I go to put the clip in and open it with one hand - it literally JUMPED out of my hand! Will give to my tween niece. I’ve been looking for this exact style that I bought at Kmart 1 yr ago.

reviews.t: Not for people with thick hair!
reviews.x: I thought these were normal size, but these are small. In retrospect, I went back and saw they offered measurements but I think the info should be in the description or the very first piece of product information. I can't believe I spent this much on these little clips!

I ordered these as I have really thick hair, my granddaughter's hair is even thicker than mine. These clips will hold your hair back, and do not have to constantly be readjusted. You put them in and they stay until you take them out. LOVE THAT!

When I use these in my hair it can be a real battle to get them in. The part you hold in your hand is too small or the spring is too tight and it takes me a few times of them flipping on the floor before the clip makes it to my hair.

These clips are very sturdy and not too large. They are perfect for someone with fine, not too long hair. They’ve been invaluable during this awful time when most of us are concerned with more pressing matters!

reviews.t: Medium size clips, worth the money
reviews.x: I put the size in the header so you don’t make the same mistake I did… I thought they were the full size clips but still worth the money as they hold a large amount of hair and very sturdy built.
The handles for the clips are at an angle where it’s impossible (for me at least) to open them with one hand. Makes it difficult to gather the hair in one hand and clip it with the other.
Nice, sturdy but extremely hard to open one handed!!! Every time I've had to use 2 hands ( or it ends up flipping out of the one hand) to open it. Just but the name brand ones.

reviews.t: I have to handle it with care because they are not  thick plastic and yet expensive.
reviews.x: I don't dislike them. It fits with my thick hair. I don't know if they are really sturdy bec. I take good care of these so it won't break easily. To me the price is expensive.
I was looking for a medium sized clip to pin back my fine hair. The larger clips are just too big. My hair falls out in between the teeth. These are perfect.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these clips work well and hold their hair securely, especially for fine or thin hair.
Several reviewers say the clips are smaller than expected or the listing description is inaccurate about size.
Some reviewers consider the clips flimsy or poor value, comparing them to dollar-store quality.
A few reviewers note the clips are hard to open with one hand due to short tabs.
Some reviewers with thin hair report the clips are too big for their hair.
